description: Account management procedures are not implemented, including account creation, modification, disabling, and termination processes.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing account management procedures, lack of account approval workflows, absence of account review processes, no monitoring of account usage, and missing documentation of authorized users and access levels.

sources.title: FISMA - Federal Information Security Modernization Act
